response.sql: WITH station_data AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count FROM station_data) SELECT sd.observstation, sd.avg_bandwidth, sd.telescope_count, sd.telescope_count / oa.avg_telescope_count as ratio FROM station_data sd CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
